summary: Separate discussion from decisions and capture actions without inventing commitments.
intents: pull the action items out of these notes
what was actually decided in the call
write minutes for the board meeting
turn this recording summary into follow-ups
prerequisites: meeting notes, transcript, or recording transcript supplied by the user
meeting purpose and date when available
verify: Decisions, open questions and actions are separated
Every action has an owner and due date only if stated in the source
Nothing is attributed to a person who did not say it
